title: Choose the dashboard composition
question: The Practice Archive identity is fixed. Choose the dashboard structure that should carry across the platform.

options.label: Archive Grid
options.thesis: A wide daily edition leads into a compact grid of subject records.
options.viewport: A horizontal daily set and progress counter sit above a three-column subject collection.
options.risk: The lower grid can read as card-heavy if borders become too prominent.

options.label: Archive Spine
options.thesis: A tall daily edition anchors a dense performance ledger and subject table.
options.viewport: The daily set occupies the left third while progress and all subject editions scan in one compact column.
options.risk: The tall orange field has less flexibility on narrow laptop heights.

options.label: Open Edition
options.lineage: opened archive label and two-column index
options.thesis: A wide open daily edition keeps the task dominant while the category archive becomes a calm list.
options.viewport: A split daily sheet leads, followed by a ruled performance strip and two-column category index.
options.risk: The compact category list gives recommendations less room for explanatory copy.
